'''Tampering''' in the context of a [[process control|controlled process]] is adjusting the process on the basis of outcomes which are within the expected range of variability. The net result is to re-align the process so that an increased proportion of the output is out of specification. The term was introduced in this context by [[W. Edwards Deming]], and he was a strong proponent of using control charts to avoid tampering.
